---
title: "Myeloid-like Blast Differential Analysis and Figure 3 Panels"
output: html_notebook
---

# Overview

This notebook covers the full myeloid-like blast analysis pipeline in four stages:

**Stage 1 — Overview plots**
Cell composition bar charts showing how myeloid-like, HSC-like, and B-lineage
blast frequencies vary by patient, stage, subtype, and dASP cluster.

**Stage 2 — Myeloid compartment changes (IDX → MRD)**
Paired frequency plots testing whether myeloid-like arrest-state fractions
change significantly between diagnosis and MRD timepoints.

**Stage 3 — Differential gene expression (myeloid-like vs B-lineage)**
MAST DEGs comparing myeloid-like blasts to B-lineage blasts, run
cohort-wide and split by subtype. Common and CD-marker genes are identified
across subtypes using a reusable helper function.

**Stage 4 — Differential TF activity (myeloid-like vs B-lineage)**
chromVAR FindMarkers (LR test) identifying TF motifs with differential
accessibility between blast lineages, filtered by gene expression.

**Stage 5 — Figure 3 manuscript panels**
Final figure assembly from pre-computed enrichment tables (Metascape output):
GO diverging bar chart, myeloid TRN heatmap, B-lineage TRN heatmap,
pseudobulk GO bar chart, and TC IDX GO tile plot.

# Helper functions

```{r helpers}
# assign_blast_lineage ---------------------------------------------------
# Adds Blast_Lineage and (optionally) Blast_Lineage_Subsets columns to a
# metadata data frame using the lineage maps defined in USER CONFIGURATION.
assign_blast_lineage <- function(meta_df, add_subsets = TRUE) {
  meta_df <- meta_df %>%
    mutate(Blast_Lineage = case_when(
      Projected.Ctype.Wmethod %in% MYELOID_CTYPES ~ "Myeloid-like",
      Projected.Ctype.Wmethod %in% HSC_CTYPES     ~ "HSC-like",
      Projected.Ctype.Wmethod %in% NK_T_CTYPES    ~ "NK_T-cell",
      Projected.Ctype.Wmethod %in% B_CTYPES       ~ "B-lineage"
    ))
  if (add_subsets) {
    meta_df <- meta_df %>%
      mutate(Blast_Lineage_Subsets = case_when(
        Projected.Ctype.Wmethod %in% MYELOID_CTYPES ~ Projected.Ctype.Wmethod,
        .default = Blast_Lineage
      ))
  }
  meta_df
}

# remove_unpaired -------------------------------------------------------
# Removes patients with only one timepoint for a given grouping variable,
# which would break paired statistical tests.
remove_unpaired <- function(df, group_var, pt_var = "PT.number") {
  df %>%
    group_by(.data[[group_var]], .data[[pt_var]]) %>%
    filter(n() != 1) %>%
    arrange(.data[[group_var]], .data[[pt_var]]) %>%
    ungroup()
}

# find_common_markers ---------------------------------------------------
# For each element of deg_list, filters DEGs by the supplied thresholds,
# then finds genes shared across all subtypes and across the three most
# common subtypes. When cd_markers is supplied, an additional filter
# restricts to CD-antigen genes only.
#
# Returns a named list with elements:
#   myeloid_all    : myeloid-enriched genes across all subtypes
#   myeloid_3      : myeloid-enriched genes in 3 of 4 subtypes
#   b_all          : B-lineage-enriched genes across all subtypes
#   b_3            : B-lineage-enriched genes in 3 of 4 subtypes
find_common_markers <- function(deg_list,
                                padj_cutoff = 0.01,
                                lfc_cutoff  = 0.5,
                                cd_markers  = NULL) {
  filter_genes <- function(df, direction, cd_syms = NULL) {
    df <- df %>%
      filter(p_val_adj < padj_cutoff,
             if (direction == "myeloid") avg_log2FC >  lfc_cutoff
             else                        avg_log2FC < -lfc_cutoff,
             blast.traj == if (direction == "myeloid") "Myeloid" else "B-cell")
    if (!is.null(cd_syms)) df <- df %>% filter(gene %in% cd_syms)
    df$gene
  }

  cd_syms <- if (!is.null(cd_markers)) cd_markers$Approved.symbol else NULL

  myl_lists <- lapply(deg_list, filter_genes, direction = "myeloid",
                       cd_syms = cd_syms)
  b_lists   <- lapply(deg_list, filter_genes, direction = "b",
                       cd_syms = cd_syms)

  list(
    myeloid_all = Reduce(base::intersect, myl_lists),
    myeloid_3   = Reduce(base::intersect, myl_lists[1:3]),
    b_all       = Reduce(base::intersect, b_lists),
    b_3         = Reduce(base::intersect, b_lists[1:3])
  )
}

# make_volcano ----------------------------------------------------------
# Wrapper for EnhancedVolcano with consistent styling across all panels.
make_volcano <- function(df, gene_col = "gene", lfc_col = "avg_log2FC",
                          padj_col = "p_val_adj",
                          fc_cutoff = MAST_LFC_ALL, p_cutoff = 0.05,
                          title = "", select_labs = NULL,
                          col_custom = NULL, xlim = c(-2.2, 2.2)) {
  EnhancedVolcano(df %>% dplyr::select(all_of(c(gene_col, lfc_col, padj_col))),
                  lab           = df[[gene_col]],
                  x             = lfc_col, y = padj_col,
                  drawConnectors  = TRUE,
                  min.segment.length = 0.5,
                  FCcutoff        = fc_cutoff,
                  pCutoff         = p_cutoff,
                  xlim            = xlim,
                  title           = title,
                  selectLab       = select_labs,
                  colCustom       = col_custom,
                  labSize         = 3)
}
```

# STAGE 1: Load data and compute blast lineage frequencies

```{r load-data}
global.rna <- readRDS(path.global.rna)

meta <- read.csv(path.projection.meta, row.names = 1) %>%
  assign_blast_lineage()

global.rna <- AddMetaData(global.rna, metadata = meta)
Idents(global.rna) <- "Ctype.Aggregate"
global.rna <- subset(global.rna, idents = EXCLUDE_CTYPES, invert = TRUE)
global.rna <- RunUMAP(global.rna, dims = 1:40, reduction = "pca")

# Per-cell metadata for frequency analysis
global.meta <- global.rna@meta.data %>%
  mutate(PT.number = factor(PT.number),
         Stage     = factor(Stage, levels = c("IDX", "MRD")))

# Blast lineage frequency per patient × stage (broad: B/HSC/Myeloid)
blast.freq <- global.meta %>%
  group_by(Subtype, PT.number, Stage, Blast_Lineage) %>%
  summarize(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Subtype, PT.number, Stage) %>%
  mutate(freq  = n / sum(n),
         label = paste0(Stage, "_", PT.number)) %>%
  filter(PT.number %notin% EXCLUDE_PATIENTS) %>%
  arrange(PT.number, Stage)
blast.freq$label <- factor(blast.freq$label, levels = unique(blast.freq$label))

# Fine-grained frequency per patient × stage × arrest-state
blast.freq.dt <- global.meta %>%
  group_by(Subtype, PT.number, Stage, Projected.Ctype.Wmethod) %>%
  summarize(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Subtype, PT.number, Stage) %>%
  mutate(freq  = n / sum(n),
         label = paste0(Stage, "_", PT.number)) %>%
  filter(PT.number %notin% EXCLUDE_PATIENTS) %>%
  arrange(PT.number, Stage)
blast.freq.dt$label <- factor(blast.freq.dt$label,
                               levels = unique(blast.freq.dt$label))
blast.freq.dt$Projected.Ctype.Wmethod <- factor(
  blast.freq.dt$Projected.Ctype.Wmethod, levels = ARREST_STATE_ORDER
)
```

## Stage 1 plots

```{r overview-plots, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
myl.blasts <- subset(global.rna, idents = c("Mature-Myeloid", "Myeloid-Progenitor"))

# Per-subtype composition bar charts
p1  <- myl.blasts@meta.data %>%
  ggplot(aes(Subtype)) + geom_bar(aes(fill = Stage)) + ggtitle("Stage")

p2  <- myl.blasts@meta.data %>%
  ggplot(aes(Subtype)) + geom_bar(aes(fill = PT.number)) +
  ggtitle("Patient Number") + guides(fill = "none")

p3  <- myl.blasts@meta.data %>%
  ggplot(aes(Subtype)) + geom_bar(aes(fill = Projected.Ctype.Wmethod)) +
  ggtitle("Arrest State") +
  theme(legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
        legend.key.size = unit(0.25, "cm")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = ARREST_STATE_COLORS) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(title.position = "top", title.hjust = 0.5))

p4  <- myl.blasts@meta.data %>%
  ggplot(aes(Stage)) + geom_bar(aes(fill = Projected.Ctype.Wmethod),
                                  position = "fill", linewidth = 0.15,
                                  color = "black") +
  ggtitle("Arrest State by Stage") +
  theme(legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
        legend.key.size = unit(0.25, "cm")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = ARREST_STATE_COLORS) +
  facet_wrap(~ Subtype, ncol = 4)

# Arrest-state frequency per patient pair (nested facet)
p11 <- blast.freq.dt %>%
  filter(PT.number %notin% "PT5") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Stage, y = freq)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = Projected.Ctype.Wmethod), position = "fill",
            linewidth = 0.05, color = "black") +
  facet_wrap(~ Subtype + PT.number, scales = "free_x", nrow = 4) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1, size = 7)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = ARREST_STATE_COLORS)

p12 <- blast.freq.dt %>%
  filter(PT.number %notin% "PT5") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Stage, y = freq)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = Projected.Ctype.Wmethod), position = "fill",
            linewidth = 0.05, color = "black") +
  ggh4x::facet_nested(~ Subtype + PT.number, scales = "free_x", bleed = TRUE) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1, size = 7)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = ARREST_STATE_COLORS)

pdf(file.path(dir.plots, "Myeloid_Blasts_Overview.pdf"), height = 6, width = 10)
ggarrange(p1, p2, p3, nrow = 1, ncol = 3, common.legend = FALSE, legend = "bottom")
ggarrange(p4, nrow = 1, common.legend = FALSE, legend = "bottom")
dev.off()

ggsave(p11, filename = file.path(dir.plots, "Proj.Ctype.byPatientPair.eps"),
       device = "eps", width = 8, height = 10)
ggsave(p12, filename = file.path(dir.plots, "Proj.Ctype.byPatientPair_nested.eps"),
       device = "eps", width = 20, height = 4)
```

# STAGE 2: Myeloid compartment changes (IDX → MRD)

```{r myeloid-changes}
# Build per-cell metadata with lineage assignments and dASP cluster
metadata_to_add <- read.csv(path.blast.meta, row.names = 1) %>%
  assign_blast_lineage() %>%
  filter(Level1.anno == "Blast", Stage != "RLP",
         PT.number %notin% EXCLUDE_PATIENTS)

dasp.clusters <- read.csv(path.dasp.clusters, row.names = "X") %>%
  dplyr::select(Row.names, k_4_Myeloid) %>%
  rename(PT.number = Row.names, k_cluster = k_4_Myeloid)

metadata_to_add <- metadata_to_add %>%
  left_join(dasp.clusters, by = "PT.number")

# Cell-type frequency by lineage (broad)
Ctype_count_byStage_Lineage <- metadata_to_add %>%
  filter(!Projected.Ctype.Wmethod %in% EXCLUDE_CTYPES,
         Stage %in% c("IDX", "MRD")) %>%
  group_by(Patient.Sample, Stage) %>%
  mutate(n = n()) %>%
  group_by(Patient.Sample, Stage, Blast_Lineage) %>%
  mutate(cell_n = n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(freq = cell_n / n) %>%
  dplyr::select(-patient_bc) %>%
  distinct()

Ctype_count_byStage_Lineage$Stage <- factor(
  Ctype_count_byStage_Lineage$Stage, levels = c("IDX", "MRD"))

# Paired plot: myeloid lineage fraction by subtype
myl.lineage <- Ctype_count_byStage_Lineage %>%
  filter(Blast_Lineage == "Myeloid-like") %>%
  dplyr::select(Blast_Lineage, PT.number, freq, Stage, Subtype) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  remove_unpaired("Blast_Lineage")

pdf(file.path(dir.plots, "MyeloidLineageFraction_IDXvsMRD_bySubtype.pdf"),
    height = 6, width = 6)

ggpaired(myl.lineage, x = "Stage", y = "freq", color = "Stage",
         facet.by = "Subtype", point.size = 0.5, id = "PT.number",
         line.color = "gray", line.size = 0.25, scales = "free_y",
         ncol = 5, width = 0.5) +
  stat_compare_means(paired = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE, label = "p.signif",
                     hide.ns = TRUE, label.x.npc = "center")

dev.off()

# Myeloid-HSC frequency correlation scatter (IDX and MRD separately)
BlastLineage_freq_wide <- Ctype_count_byStage_Lineage %>%
  dplyr::select(PT.number, Blast_Lineage, freq, Stage, MRD.Group) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Blast_Lineage, values_from = freq)

pdf(file.path(dir.plots, "MyeloidFrequency_Correlation.pdf"),
    height = 5, width = 7)

for (stage0 in c("IDX", "MRD")) {
  print(
    BlastLineage_freq_wide %>%
      filter(Stage == stage0) %>%
      ggplot(aes(x = `Myeloid-like`, y = `HSC-like`)) +
      geom_point() +
      labs(title = paste("Myeloid vs HSC-like frequency:", stage0))
  )
}

# Myeloid frequency by MRD group at each stage
for (stage0 in c("IDX", "MRD")) {
  p <- Ctype_count_byStage_Lineage %>%
    filter(Blast_Lineage == "Myeloid-like", Stage == stage0) %>%
    dplyr::select(PT.number, freq, MRD.Group) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    ggboxplot(x = "MRD.Group", y = "freq",
               title = paste("Myeloid Cell Frequency by MRD Group at", stage0))
  print(p)
}

dev.off()
```

# STAGE 3: Differential gene expression — myeloid-like vs B-lineage

## 3.1 Cohort-wide DEGs

```{r myeloid-vs-b-deg}
Idents(global.rna) <- "Ctype.Aggregate"
myeloid.cells <- WhichCells(global.rna,
                              idents = c("Mature-Myeloid", "Myeloid-Progenitor"))
b.cells       <- WhichCells(global.rna,
                              idents = c("CLP", "Immature-Mature-B",
                                         "Pre-pro-B", "Pro-B-Pre-B"))

myl.vs.b.deg <- FindMarkers(global.rna,
                              ident.1             = myeloid.cells,
                              ident.2             = b.cells,
                              test.use            = "MAST",
                              min.pct             = MAST_MIN_PCT,
                              max.cells.per.ident = 10000,
                              latent.vars         = "PT.number") %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
  mutate(blast.traj = if_else(avg_log2FC > 0, "Myeloid", "B-cell"))

# Volcano colour map: myeloid-enriched = red, B-lineage = blue, NS = gray
keyvals.myl.b <- ifelse(
  myl.vs.b.deg$p_val_adj < 0.05 & myl.vs.b.deg$avg_log2FC >  MAST_LFC_ALL, "red",
  ifelse(myl.vs.b.deg$p_val_adj < 0.05 & myl.vs.b.deg$avg_log2FC < -MAST_LFC_ALL,
         "royalblue", "gray"))
names(keyvals.myl.b)[keyvals.myl.b == "red"]      <- "Myeloid-like"
names(keyvals.myl.b)[keyvals.myl.b == "gray"]     <- "NS"
names(keyvals.myl.b)[keyvals.myl.b == "royalblue"] <- "B-lineage"

all.blasts.volcano <- make_volcano(myl.vs.b.deg,
                                    fc_cutoff    = MAST_LFC_ALL,
                                    title        = "All Myeloid-Like Blasts vs. B-lineage",
                                    select_labs  = MYL_GENES_TO_LABEL,
                                    col_custom   = keyvals.myl.b)

write.csv(myl.vs.b.deg,
          file.path(dir.tables, "MyeloidvsBLineageBlasts_DEG.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
```

## 3.2 Subtype-specific DEGs

```{r subtype-degs, eval=FALSE}
# Set RERUN_SUBTYPE_DEGS = TRUE in config to re-run FindMarkers from scratch.
# Otherwise, load the pre-saved RDS.
if (RERUN_SUBTYPE_DEGS) {
  subtype.blasts   <- SplitObject(global.rna, split.by = "Subtype")
  subtype.deg.list <- lapply(names(subtype.blasts), function(st) {
    obj         <- subtype.blasts[[st]]
    myl.cells   <- WhichCells(obj, idents = c("Mature-Myeloid", "Myeloid-Progenitor"))
    b.cells.sub <- WhichCells(obj, idents = c("CLP", "Immature-Mature-B",
                                                "Pre-pro-B", "Pro-B-Pre-B"))
    markers <- FindMarkers(obj,
                            ident.1             = myl.cells,
                            ident.2             = b.cells.sub,
                            logfc.threshold     = MAST_LFC_SUBTYPE,
                            test.use            = "MAST",
                            min.pct             = MAST_MIN_PCT,
                            max.cells.per.ident = min(length(myl.cells),
                                                       length(b.cells.sub)),
                            latent.vars         = c("PT.number", "Stage"))
    markers %>%
      rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
      filter(!grepl("^MT-", gene), p_val_adj < 0.05) %>%
      mutate(blast.traj = if_else(avg_log2FC > 0, "Myeloid", "B-cell"))
  })
  names(subtype.deg.list) <- names(subtype.blasts)
  saveRDS(subtype.deg.list, path.subtype.degs)
} else {
  subtype.deg.list <- readRDS(path.subtype.degs)
}
```

## 3.3 Common and CD-marker genes across subtypes

`find_common_markers()` applies identical logic to both the unrestricted DEG
set and the CD-antigen subset; the `cd_markers` argument switches between them.

```{r common-markers}
# All DEGs shared across subtypes
common.all <- find_common_markers(
  subtype.deg.list,
  padj_cutoff = 0.01,
  lfc_cutoff  = MAST_LFC_SUBTYPE
)

cat("Myeloid genes shared across all subtypes:", length(common.all$myeloid_all), "\n")
print(noquote(common.all$myeloid_all))
cat("B-lineage genes shared across all subtypes:", length(common.all$b_all), "\n")
print(noquote(common.all$b_all))

# CD-antigen subset
cd.markers <- read.csv(path.cd.markers)
common.cd <- find_common_markers(
  subtype.deg.list,
  padj_cutoff = 0.01,
  lfc_cutoff  = MAST_LFC_SUBTYPE,
  cd_markers  = cd.markers
)

cat("Myeloid CD genes shared across all subtypes:", length(common.cd$myeloid_all), "\n")
print(common.cd$myeloid_all)
cat("B-lineage CD genes shared across all subtypes:", length(common.cd$b_all), "\n")
print(common.cd$b_all)
```

## 3.4 Volcano re-plots (from pre-computed objects)

```{r volcano-replots}
load(path.myl.deg.rdata)
# Expected objects: myl.vs.b.deg, myl.vs.b.mrd.deg, myl.vs.b.idx.deg,
#                   mrd.vs.idx.myl.deg, mrd.vs.idx.b.deg

# Annotate unique vs common DEGs (unique to myeloid, not shared with B)
b.idx   <- mrd.vs.idx.b.deg   %>% filter(blast.traj == "IDX") %>% pull(gene)
b.mrd   <- mrd.vs.idx.b.deg   %>% filter(blast.traj == "MRD") %>% pull(gene)
myl.idx <- mrd.vs.idx.myl.deg %>% filter(blast.traj == "IDX") %>% pull(gene)
myl.mrd <- mrd.vs.idx.myl.deg %>% filter(blast.traj == "MRD") %>% pull(gene)

mrd.vs.idx.myl.deg <- mrd.vs.idx.myl.deg %>%
  mutate(unique = case_when(
    blast.traj == "IDX" & gene %notin% b.idx ~ "unique",
    blast.traj == "MRD" & gene %notin% b.mrd ~ "unique",
    .default = "common"
  ))

# Colour map: unique DEGs = green, common DEGs = blue
keyvals.unique <- ifelse(mrd.vs.idx.myl.deg$unique == "unique",
                          "forestgreen", "royalblue")
keyvals.unique[is.na(keyvals.unique)] <- "black"
names(keyvals.unique)[keyvals.unique == "forestgreen"] <- "Unique DEG"
names(keyvals.unique)[keyvals.unique == "royalblue"]   <- "Common DEG"
names(keyvals.unique)[keyvals.unique == "black"]       <- "DEG"

p1 <- make_volcano(myl.vs.b.deg,
                    fc_cutoff   = MAST_LFC_ALL,
                    title       = "Myeloid-Like Blasts vs. B-lineage",
                    select_labs = MYL_GENES_TO_LABEL,

                    select_labs = MYL_STAGE_GENES_TO_LABEL,
                    col_custom  = keyvals.unique)

pdf(file.path(dir.plots, "Myl_VolcanoPlot.pdf"), width = 5, height = 8)
p1

pdf(file.path(dir.plots, "Myl_IDXvsMRD_VolcanoPlot.pdf"), width = 6, height = 6)
```

# STAGE 4: Differential TF activity (chromVAR)

```{r dtf-setup}
chromVAR.ds  <- readRDS(path.chromvar)
seurat.atac.ds <- readRDS(path.atac.seurat)

# Strip database prefix from chromVAR motif names to recover TF gene names
z.score.ds <- chromVAR.ds@assays@data$z
rownames(z.score.ds) <- sapply(rownames(z.score.ds),
                                function(x) strsplit(x, "_")[[1]][3])

# Build joint ATAC + chromVAR object, filtered to blast cells IDX/MRD
seurat.atac.ds.sub <- subset(seurat.atac.ds, cells = colnames(chromVAR.ds))
seurat.atac.ds.sub[["chromvar"]] <- CreateAssayObject(z.score.ds)

# Attach blast metadata
meta.ds <- metadata_to_add %>%
  filter(patient_bc %in% colnames(chromVAR.ds)) %>%
  assign_blast_lineage() %>%
  as.data.frame()
rownames(meta.ds) <- meta.ds$patient_bc

Idents(seurat.atac.ds.sub) <- "Level1.anno"
seurat.atac.ds.sub <- subset(seurat.atac.ds.sub, idents = "Blast")
seurat.atac.ds.sub <- AddMetaData(seurat.atac.ds.sub, meta.ds) %>%
  subset(subset = Blast_Lineage != "NK_T-cell")

Idents(seurat.atac.ds.sub) <- "Stage"
seurat.atac.ds.sub <- subset(seurat.atac.ds.sub, idents = c("IDX", "MRD"))

# Stratified object list: all blasts, IDX only, MRD only
Idents(seurat.atac.ds.sub) <- "Blast_Lineage"
seurat.obj.list <- list(
  All_Blasts     = seurat.atac.ds.sub,
  All_IDX_Blasts = subset(seurat.atac.ds.sub,
                            subset = Stage == "IDX"),
  All_MRD_Blasts = subset(seurat.atac.ds.sub,
                            subset = Stage == "MRD")
)
```

```{r dtf-findmarkers}
# Run DTF analysis for each stratum and save results
for (stratum in names(seurat.obj.list)) {
  obj <- seurat.obj.list[[stratum]]
  Idents(obj) <- "Blast_Lineage"
  min.cells <- min(table(obj$Blast_Lineage,
                          obj$Stage)[c("B-lineage", "Myeloid-like"), ])

  dtf <- FindMarkers(obj,
                      ident.1             = "Myeloid-like",
                      ident.2             = "B-lineage",
                      test.use            = "LR",
                      latent.vars         = "PTnumber",
                      max.cells.per.ident = min.cells,
                      assay               = "chromvar")
  dtf <- data.table(dtf, keep.rownames = TRUE)

  # Expression filter: TF gene must be expressed in >= 10% of cells
  # in the relevant lineage (reduces motif-only false positives)
  meta.sub  <- meta.ds[meta.ds$patient_bc %in% rownames(obj@meta.data), ]
  rna.myl   <- global.rna@assays$RNA@counts[,
    meta.sub[meta.sub$Blast_Lineage == "Myeloid-like", ]$patient_bc]
  rna.b     <- global.rna@assays$RNA@counts[,
    meta.sub[meta.sub$Blast_Lineage == "B-lineage",    ]$patient_bc]

  expr.myl  <- names(which(Matrix::rowSums(rna.myl > 0) >= 0.1 * ncol(rna.myl)))
  expr.b    <- names(which(Matrix::rowSums(rna.b   > 0) >= 0.1 * ncol(rna.b)))

  filtered.tfs <- unique(c(
    dtf[rn %in% expr.myl & avg_log2FC > 0, rn],
    dtf[rn %in% expr.b   & avg_log2FC < 0, rn]
  ))

  write.table(dtf[rn %in% filtered.tfs],
              quote = FALSE, sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE,
              file = file.path(dir.tables,
                                paste0(stratum,
                                       "_EnrichedTFs_MyeloidVsB_filteredbyexpression.txt")))
  cat(stratum, "DTFs saved:", nrow(dtf[rn %in% filtered.tfs]), "\n")
}
```

```{r dtf-volcano}
all.tf <- read.delim(file.path(dir.tables,
                                "All_Blasts_EnrichedTFs_MyeloidVsB_filteredbyexpression.txt"))
idx.tf <- read.delim(file.path(dir.tables,
                                "All_IDX_Blasts_EnrichedTFs_MyeloidVsB_filteredbyexpression.txt"))
mrd.tf <- read.delim(file.path(dir.tables,
                                "All_MRD_Blasts_EnrichedTFs_MyeloidVsB_filteredbyexpression.txt"))

make_tf_keyvals <- function(df, lfc_cutoff, padj_cutoff) {
  kv <- ifelse(df$p_val_adj < padj_cutoff & df$avg_log2FC >  lfc_cutoff, "red",
         ifelse(df$p_val_adj < padj_cutoff & df$avg_log2FC < -lfc_cutoff,
                "royalblue", "gray"))
  names(kv)[kv == "red"]       <- "Myeloid-like"
  names(kv)[kv == "gray"]      <- "NS"
  names(kv)[kv == "royalblue"] <- "B-lineage"
  kv
}

pdf(file.path(dir.plots, "AllBlasts_TFActivity.pdf"), height = 8, width = 6)
make_volcano(all.tf %>% rename(gene = rn),
              fc_cutoff  = TF_LFC_CUTOFF,
              col_custom = make_tf_keyvals(all.tf, TF_LFC_CUTOFF, TF_PADJ_CUTOFF),
              title      = "All TF Activity: B-lineage vs. Myeloid-like Blasts")
make_volcano(idx.tf %>% rename(gene = rn),
              fc_cutoff = TF_LFC_CUTOFF,
              title     = "IDX TF Activity: B-lineage vs. Myeloid-like Blasts")
make_volcano(mrd.tf %>% rename(gene = rn),
              fc_cutoff = TF_LFC_CUTOFF,
              title     = "MRD TF Activity: B-lineage vs. Myeloid-like Blasts")
dev.off()
```

# STAGE 5: Figure 3 manuscript panels

All enrichment tables below are sourced from Metascape pathway analysis
run on DEG lists from Stage 3 and TRN regulon gene lists from Stage 4.

## 5.1 GO diverging bar chart (myeloid vs B-lineage)

```{r fig3-go-bar}
# GO enrichment sourced from Metascape output; columns: GO, Description,
# B-lineage (-log10 p), Myeloid-like (-log10 p)
my.go <- read.csv(path.myl.go.csv)
colnames(my.go) <- c("GO", "Description", "B-lineage", "Myeloid-like")

my.go.long <- my.go %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c("B-lineage", "Myeloid-like"),
               names_to  = "Lineage",
               values_to = "Enrichment_Score") %>%
  # Mirror B-lineage scores to the left for the diverging layout
  mutate(EnrichmentScore = if_else(Lineage == "B-lineage",
                                    Enrichment_Score, -Enrichment_Score))

p.go.bar <- ggplot(my.go.long,
                    aes(x = reorder(Description, -EnrichmentScore),
                        y = EnrichmentScore, fill = Lineage)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "identity") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "-log10(p.adj) (mirrored)",
       title = "GO Enrichment: Myeloid-like vs B-lineage (Metascape)") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank())

pdf(file.path(dir.fig3, "MyeloidVsB_GO_divergingBar.pdf"), height = 4, width = 8)
p.go.bar
dev.off()
```

## 5.2 TRN pathway heatmaps (Metascape)

```{r fig3-trn-heatmaps}
# Helper: load Metascape heatmap CSV and strip column prefix
load_metascape_heatmap <- function(path) {
  df           <- read.csv(path)
  new_cols     <- sub("X_LogP_Transcription.Factor.", "", colnames(df[, 3:ncol(df)]))
  colnames(df) <- c(colnames(df[, 1:2]), new_cols)
  df
}

my.trn.go <- load_metascape_heatmap(path.myl.trn.csv)
b.trn.go  <- load_metascape_heatmap(path.b.trn.csv)

# Subset myeloid TRN heatmap to key TFs defined in config
my.trn.subset <- my.trn.go[, c("GO", "Description", MYL_TRN_TFS)]

pdf(file.path(dir.fig3, "Myeloid_TRN_pathway_heatmap.pdf"), height = 4, width = 6)
ComplexHeatmap::pheatmap(
  -my.trn.subset[, MYL_TRN_TFS],
  cluster_rows  = TRUE, cluster_cols  = TRUE,
  labels_row    = my.trn.subset$Description,
  treeheight_row = 0, treeheight_col = 0,
  color         = colorRampPalette(c("#ffffff", "#d73027"))(501),
  breaks        = seq(0, 10, by = 0.02),
  legend_breaks = c(0, 5, 10),
  column_title  = "Myeloid TRN — Metascape"
)
dev.off()
```

## 5.3 TC IDX GO enrichment tile plot (Metascape)

```{r fig3-tc-go-tile}
tc.go <- read.csv(path.tc.idx.go.csv) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("X_LogP_"),
               names_to  = "TC",
               values_to = "LogP") %>%
  mutate(TC   = str_replace(TC, "X_LogP_", ""),
         LogP = abs(LogP))

tc.go$Description <- factor(tc.go$Description,
                              levels = rev(unique(read.csv(path.tc.idx.go.csv)$Description)))

p.tc.tile <- ggplot(tc.go, aes(x = TC, y = Description, fill = LogP)) +
  geom_tile(color = "gray", linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "red",
                       limits = c(0, max(tc.go$LogP)),
                       name   = "-Log(P-value)") +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Bidirectional", "HSPC/\nMyeloid",
                                "Immature/\nMature-B", "Mature-B")) +
  labs(title = "TC IDX Signature GO Enrichment (Metascape)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(axis.text.x  = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1),
        axis.title   = element_blank(),
        panel.grid   = element_blank())

ggsave(file.path(dir.fig3, "TC_IDX_GO_heatmap.pdf"),
       p.tc.tile, width = 7, height = 5)
```
